question: A group of researchers is looking to study the effect of body weight on blood pressure in the elderly. Previous work measuring body weight and blood pressure at 2-time points in a large group of healthy individuals revealed that a 10% increase in body weight was accompanied by a 7 mm Hg increase in blood pressure. If the researchers want to determine if there is a linear relationship between body weight and blood pressure in a subgroup of elderly individuals in this study, which of the following statistical methods would best be employed to answer this question?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Body weight" -> "associated with 7 mm Hg increase in blood pressure" -> "suggests a linear relationship" -> "Pearson’s correlation" -> 80% confidence. analysis: Since the researchers are looking to determine if there is a linear relationship between body weight and blood pressure in a subgroup of elderly individuals, the most appropriate statistical method would be Pearson’s correlation. This method will help assess the strength and direction of the linear relationship between body weight and blood pressure.
